speaker: abel_garnish
text: The February book is not in the house. I have the plot. I have not got the play. Friday is the old Knave, and nobody has it.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: Then I will start where it failed in February. Give me the middle.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: It is gone. Master Garnish, I ask your pardon. That is the same place.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: It is the same place. Walk it again.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: Gone again. Master Heminges, I ask your pardon. I gave you the entrance and not the words.

speaker: john_heminges
text: You gave me neither. The sun is over the gallery. Again.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: No. Master Pope, I ask your pardon. I have fetched you on in the wrong shape.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: The shape is not your doing. The tireman has padded me to a barrel.

speaker: john_sincler
text: And he has nothing for me. This doublet would fit a rake.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: He needs none. He is the before, and I'm the after.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Stand, and do not build a scene on it. Where is Kemp?

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Not come. He is at his slippers.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Then the book goes on without him. Dick, the same place.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: Gone. Master Shakespeare, I ask your pardon. You were not in it, and I have stepped on you all the same.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: My eight lines are a justice. They are not your hole. The pardon is taken.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Put the rolls down. I am done with prompting. I will read the play aloud, and you will walk.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Read, then. I am looking at the sun, and the sun is not helping.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: The justice. Master Shakespeare, if you have him.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I have the eight. I will not make a ninth for company.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: All eight, and in order. That is a strange thing to thank a man for, on this morning.

speaker: john_sincler
text: Then hear the thanks, and hear that they are not kind. Eight lines of a justice, right, while the rest of the book is February.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: I dried four times. I named four men. Garnish, then John, then Tom, then Will. The place is the same place.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The Rose has Hercules again. We break at eleven. We are no better than we were at nine.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Eleven, then. Friday is the play. This morning is not a mending.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: The plot stays on the peg. I have read till the mouth is dry, and the book is not in you.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: I will stand on Friday. I will not kneel in a barrel.

speaker: john_sincler
text: Give me a doublet that meets, or I play the lean man in my shirt. The tireman has had his say in cloth.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: I will look at the hole once more before Friday. I do not promise it is gone.

speaker: john_heminges
text: No promise. Eleven. That is the end of it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Eight lines, and a company no better. I will not call that a triumph on the stair.
